data.reason: I act for the service operator. My authority covers the rules, the contract and the reading of the KPI, but not the regulation. Option 1 cannot pass as an ordinary rule change because the votes were A ○, B ×, C ×. Adopting it would need either a one-off override or R1 (vote.quorum 2 → 1), and both are regulation-layer decisions reserved for the regulation officer. Customers bear the cost of keeping v1: about 7 more late deliveries per period, and the weakest company stays at 0.93. The override question remains open as D1.f1 for the regulation officer. I do not settle it here, and I do not restate it.
